verdict.rationale: VirtualPostMail's developers page says an API exists alongside a Zapier integration, and other pages confirm that mail is scanned and stored online. However, nothing shows what the API exposes, and probes found no OpenAPI spec or machine-readable docs at the usual paths. The failed probes are not counter-evidence, so this is not disputed, but the developer story is only thinly evidenced. Missing for 10: documented endpoints for listing mail items, documented scan/PDF download, public API reference or OpenAPI spec, auth/webhook details, independent or hands-on corroboration.
